title.en: Legislative Analyst's analysis of Proposition 3, Official Voter Information Guide
Attorney General's title and summary of Proposition 3, with the Analyst's fiscal estimate, Official Voter Information Guide

explanation.en: The Analyst says Proposition 3 makes the higher income tax rates created by Proposition 30 permanent instead of letting them expire in 2031, and says it would maintain $5 billion to $15 billion a year of state revenue. Rates paid today would not rise, but taxpayers in the top 2 percent would pay the higher rates after 2031, when they would otherwise fall.

speaker.en: Official argument in favor of Proposition 3

text: Proposition 3 is NOT a new tax and does NOT raise taxes on anyone.
